name: Shopify Catalog
description: Search products across Shopify merchants or within one store, resolve product identifiers and inspect variants through Shopify's UCP catalogs.

tools.name: Product details
tools.description: Get details, variants and availability for a product_id returned by search or lookup. Optional selected options refine the variant. Does not create a cart or place an order.

options.name: product_id
options.about: Paste one product ID returned by search or lookup in the same catalog.

options.name: country
options.about: Buyer's two-letter country code, such as US, CA or GB, for localized results.

options.name: currency
options.about: Three-letter currency code, such as USD, CAD or GBP.

options.name: language
options.about: Preferred language tag, such as en or en-US.

options.name: region
options.about: Buyer's state, province or region, such as CA.

options.name: postal_code
options.about: Buyer's postal or ZIP code for localized results.

options.name: intent
options.about: Optional shopping preferences or intended use.

options.name: filters
options.about: Advanced filters, such as {"available":true,"price":{"max":15000}}. Price amounts use minor currency units: 15000 means USD 150.

options.name: selected
options.about: Optional variant selections, such as [{"name":"Color","label":"Black"}].

options.name: preferences
options.about: Optional preferences to help select a variant.

options.name: view
options.about: Advanced Shopify output view. Leave empty for the default representation.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Shopify product identifier; use unchanged for lookup or get_product.

fields.name: description
fields.about: May be inferred by Shopify; not necessarily merchant-authored.

fields.name: price_range
fields.about: Amounts in minor currency units, with currency codes.

fields.name: rating
fields.about: Aggregate product rating, when available.

fields.name: options
fields.about: Product options and their available values.

fields.name: metadata
fields.about: Shopify catalog extension metadata, when available.

fields.name: selected
fields.about: Effective product option selections.

response.about: Product records, product metadata and optional messages. Search includes pagination.cursor/has_next_page; repeat the original query with the returned cursor.

tools.name: Search products
tools.description: Search products across Shopify merchants by query, such as trail running shoes under $150. Narrow results by country and use limit and cursor to page through them. Results are estimates, not an exhaustive merchant inventory.

options.name: query
options.about: What are you looking for? For example: `trail running shoes`. Required unless using like for similarity search.

options.name: country
options.about: Buyer's two-letter country code, such as US, CA or GB, for localized results.

options.name: limit
options.about: Number of products per page, from 1 to 50. Shopify defaults to 10.

options.name: currency
options.about: Three-letter currency code, such as USD, CAD or GBP.

options.name: language
options.about: Preferred language tag, such as en or en-US.

options.name: cursor
options.about: For the next page, paste pagination.cursor from the previous response and keep the same search and filters.

options.name: region
options.about: Buyer's state, province or region, such as CA.

options.name: postal_code
options.about: Buyer's postal or ZIP code for localized results.

options.name: intent
options.about: Optional shopping preferences or intended use.

options.name: filters
options.about: Advanced filters, such as {"available":true,"price":{"max":15000}}. Price amounts use minor currency units: 15000 means USD 150.

options.name: like
options.about: Advanced similarity search instead of, or alongside, query. Provide up to two items as {"id":"gid://shopify/..."} or {"image":{"content_type":"image/jpeg","data":"<base64>"}}.

options.name: catalog_id
options.about: Optional saved Shopify catalog ID to restrict the search.

options.name: view
options.about: Advanced Shopify output view. Leave empty for the default representation.

fields.name: id
fields.about: Shopify product identifier; use unchanged for lookup or get_product.

fields.name: description
fields.about: May be inferred by Shopify; not necessarily merchant-authored.

fields.name: price_range
fields.about: Amounts in minor currency units, with currency codes.

fields.name: rating
fields.about: Aggregate product rating, when available.

fields.name: options
fields.about: Product options and their available values.

fields.name: metadata
fields.about: Shopify catalog extension metadata, when available.

response.about: Product records, product metadata and optional messages. Search includes pagination.cursor/has_next_page; repeat the original query with the returned cursor.
